input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Deepen flagship open-tennis-robots: azimuth drive (motor, gear, sizing, CAD, firmware) and a turned-head collision sweep
errors: First mast-plate notch polygon was self-intersecting (arc points ran the wrong way), so build123d silently did not subtract it; caught by the clash persisting and the flat area not changing.
First stepper planner landed at 9-12 deg/s instead of near rest and missed the triangular-profile time; fixed with the discrete stopping-speed formula and integer step bookkeeping.
First sizing cut the gear teeth into the 5 mm aluminium plate and guessed 0.06 kg m^2 inertia; the slot-width check and the CAD-measured 0.31 kg m^2 overturned both.
